name: Centenarian Bullion sell price and Witch Hunter caltrop size (#4508, #4502)
contract: The Centenarian Bullion vendors for 50 gold, matching its sibling currency's 2:1 relation. The Witch Hunter caltrop prop (creature 506010) renders the Outland passive doodad Caltrop01, which is authored at doodad size, so it is drawn at a small fraction of the mesh instead of at full size: the template says so, and a live cast of Caltrops 503679 - which only a Witch Hunter summons, because the summon script resolves its owner through the class - has to hand that same scale to the client. The scale is read from the summoned creature's own object-scale field, the value that reaches the wire, not from the template, because a template read alone cannot tell a cached row from a live spawn. The scatter count is the spell's own effect (BasePoints 11, DieSides 1 = 12 summons) and the hidden cauldron 506011 shares the display and stays at full size, which is why the two are asserted separately.

steps.label: its sibling coin keeps the same 2:1 relation
the caltrop spawns the caltrop doodad
at caltrop size, not doodad size
the shared hidden cauldron is untouched
casting Caltrops scatters the caltrops it says it does
and the live prop is drawn at that same small scale
